rationale: Third-party minor injured due to icy conditions on policyholder's walkway, parents discussing medical bills — clear premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Third-party premises liability claim: neighbor's 9-year-old daughter broke her wrist after slipping on icy walkway in front of policyholder's house during ice storm last week. Parents discussing medical bills. Pediatric fracture requires prompt adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.injury_description: broken wrist from slip and fall on ice
case_facts.description: third party minor injured on policyholder's icy walkway
